title: v67 ABS adhesion test - shell first 8 mm
desc: Black ABS, version 67. The shell P3a first 8.0 mm, placed where it lies in P3a. Textured PEI with glue. Chin face down, 4 walls, blockers along the chin edges and in the two bottom insert holes, 5 mm brim, tree supports in black ABS with the Support for ABS interface, prime tower behind the part. Slice in the window. Filament 1 black ABS on the main (left) nozzle, filament 2 Support for ABS on the auxiliary (right) nozzle from its external spool (D178). Shrinkage: your calibrated preset on filament 1.
